fields.description: The exact math used to compute this shape's diamond-layer volume (mm³), in Python — editable here, takes effect immediately for every Wheel Type using this shape. Flat/straight shapes (Requires Correction Factor unchecked): evaluated once, with diameter, inner_diameter, height available. Profiled/angled shapes (checked): evaluated once per Profile Segment row on the Wheel Type, with d_out_big, d_out_small, d_in_big, d_in_small, height available (the segment's own small-end diameters, already derived from its angle) — Wheel Type sums the result across every segment. pi is always available. Validated by trying it with sample numbers as soon as you save; a bad formula is rejected here, before any Wheel Type or Measurement Event ever depends on it.
fields.label: Volume Formula
